newsitem.title: USA: CBOE to list options on three stocks May 12.
newsitem.headline: CBOE to list options on three stocks May 12.

text.p: The Chicago Board Options Exchange (CBOE) said Monday it will list options on Circuit City Stores Inc-CarMax Group, PRI Automation Inc and Vail Resorts Inc May 12.

Circuit City options will trade on the January expiration cycle, with introductory expiries in June, July, October and January. Initial strike prices have been set at 12-1/2, 15 and 17-1/2. It will trade in the Sears, Roebuck & Co crowd.
PRI Automation options will trade on the February expiration cycle, with introductory expiries in June, July, August and November.
Initial strike prices for PRI Automation options have been set at 25, 30 and 35. The options will trade in the Merck & Co crowd.

Vail Resorts options will trade on the March expiration cycle, with introductory expiries in June, July, September and December. Initial strike prices have ben set at 17-1/2, 20 and 22-1/2. Eclipse was named designated primary market maker. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
